_authority: What a slide may show besides its words, and how a trainee may answer a task - with WHO makes each one: the factory itself, the factory through the nano-banana plugin, or someone outside it. Owner, 2026-09-30 (L37, L38): 'leave place for animations, images, 3D illustrations - graphic things in slides - and mention what kind would be used', and 'make these tests more variable - not only choose A B C D - as much variable as possible ... more digitalized, more realistic, more detailed, more technical; if you cannot perform, explain why and advise how'. Read by scripts/content_script.py (Stage 3: every slide names its visual; every task names its mechanic; the variety floors are checked) and scripts/make_architecture_page.py (Stage 2: the visual plan per module and who makes it). The representations themselves - what teaches which learning need - stay with course-visuals (decide/knowledge/representations.json, learning-needs.json); each kind below names the representation it is built as.

factory.how: authored SVG, HTML/CSS/JS, canvas, and three.js scenes built from geometry - all bundled into the course pack, offline (L6)

novikontas.en: needs Novikontas: a photo, a short film or a 3D scan of the real equipment

novikontas.ru: нужна Novikontas: фото, короткое видео или 3D-скан реального оборудования
novikontas.how: the school has the equipment the IMO model course lists (L28). A phone is enough: photographs; a short video; or a 3D scan with a free photogrammetry app (Polycam, KIRI Engine, RealityScan) exported as a .glb file. The factory lists exactly what to capture, from which side, and puts the file into the slide.

outside.how: a manufacturer's CAD or 3D file; a licensed model (Sketchfab, TurboSquid, CGTrader - check the licence allows training use); or a 3D artist in Blender. AI image-to-3D services (Meshy, Tripo, Rodin) can turn a picture into a .glb through their API with a key of their own - for context objects only, never equipment a trainee must recognise.

mechanics._law: No free typing on a self-check or module check (owner C11, course-task-ux §2) - every mechanic below is answered by tapping, dragging or setting a control. The 'answer' format is the one line-per-item text the operator edits in the Word file; '*' marks what is right.

single_choice.answer: options A, B, C (D); 'correct' is one letter

multi_select.answer: options A, B, C, D (E); 'correct' lists the letters, e.g. A, C

choose_and_justify.en: Choose the action, then the reason
choose_and_justify.answer: options are the actions, 'correct' one letter; the answer box lists the reasons, one per line, the right one marked *

order.answer: one step per line, in the right order - the tablet shuffles them

match.answer: one pair per line: left = right

categorise.answer: one group per line: Group: item; item; item

cloze.en: Complete the sentence (choose the missing words)
cloze.answer: the sentence, each gap as [right* | wrong | wrong]

hotspot.en: Tap the right place on the picture
hotspot.answer: one tappable area per line, the right one(s) marked *; the picture is named in 'visual'

label_diagram.en: Drag the labels onto the drawing
label_diagram.answer: one label per line, each the name of a part the drawing shows

spot_the_hazard.en: Find the hazards in the scene
spot_the_hazard.answer: one area of the scene per line, the real hazards marked *

read_instrument.answer: what the display shows, then the options - the reading and what it means; 'correct' one letter

set_value.answer: one line: value unit ± tolerance, range low-high - e.g. -42 °C ± 2, range -60 to 20

panel_operate.en: Operate the panel or line up the valves
panel_operate.lv: Darbini paneli vai sagatavo vārstu līniju
panel_operate.answer: one control per line: control = the state it must end in; the panel or drawing is named in 'visual'

scenario.en: Scenario - decide, see what happens, decide again
scenario.lv: Scenārijs - izlem, redzi sekas, izlem atkal
scenario.ru: Сценарий - реши, увидь последствия, реши снова
scenario.answer: one step per line: the situation => right action* | wrong | wrong

floors._every_slide: Owner, 2026-09-30 (2.18.1): no quota. As many pictures as the theory and the experience call for - wherever a picture, an animation or a realistic 3D illustration reflects what is being taught at that point, put it in; animation and 3D especially. A slide with none gets a suggestion, never a block. A picture that is named must say what it shows (must fix), and an unknown kind is a mistake to correct.
floors._moving: A suggestion, not a rule (2.18.1): a module with this many minutes of theory and nothing that moves, turns or can be explored is pointed out, because where something moves, changes state or has an inside, a still picture teaches it worse (course-visuals, learning-needs.json).
floors._kinds: A suggestion, not a rule (2.18.1): a module of 6 slides or more with fewer than 3 kinds of picture is pointed out - but a picture is never added only for variety (L13).
floors._tasks: A self-check uses at least 2 different mechanics and a module check at least 3; 'choose one answer' is at most 40 % of a module's questions; every module has at least one hands-on question - locate, operate or decide on something that looks like the real thing; never more than 2 questions of the same mechanic in a row. These stay rules (owner, 2026-09-30). The final assessment follows the programme's own format - none of them applies to it.
